name: deep-research
description: Deep web research as a flow: a planner chooses research directions, repeatable web researcher subagents investigate them in parallel, each researcher's quotes are checked against the pages it fetched and one independent web-enabled critic per researcher returns a typed audit (verified claims with fetched source and quote, rejected claims, open questions), a coordinator reasons across the verified evidence and decides any follow-up research within bounded rounds, and a Markdown report is written only from verified claims.
